name: Kebabangan gas field / Northern Hub
description: Offshore Technology (5 May 2016): topsides installed onto a fixed eight-leg steel jacket in place, weighing 12,300 t; deck weighs 17,000 t; installed in a water depth of 142 m (466 ft); production began November 2014 after 1994 discovery. The same page also calls it a "floating platform" — conflict recorded in gaps.
